title: Ching Maid
era: the golden age of the cloud cities
synopsis: In Once City's Pearl Passage, reigning beauty queen Mei Ching inherits Ching Maid, her grandmother's failing cleaning and concierge firm, and saves it the only way she can afford: with a crew of epic nerds who have never cleaned anything, against a city full of rival queens who run firms of their own.

world.place: Pearl Passage and its towers in Once City: the Ching family shop under the lantern arch, the domes the crew cleans, the pageant halls and the convention dome across the walkway.
people: Mei Ching
the reigning Miss Pearl Passage, a sharp businesswoman in a sash who inherits the family firm the week she is crowned
Po Po Ching
Mei's grandmother, founder of Ching Maid, who has kept every key in Pearl Passage for fifty years and knows everyone's secrets
Dex Oyelaran
a guildmaster who runs the city's biggest live-action role-play and plans every job like a raid
Kenji Moss
a speedrunner who times every task and cannot stop looking for shortcuts
Bitsy Kowal
a robot builder who would rather build a machine to clean a room than clean it
Theo Lindqvist
a quiz champion who knows everything except how to talk to Mei
Lan Yu
Miss Carat Court, Mei's oldest rival, who runs the glossiest maid firm in the city
Jade Tsai
Miss Clockwork, an engineer queen who builds her own cleaning gadgets
Coco Wen
Miss Midnight Arcade, who only works nights and only for the very rich
Vesper Lune
keeper of the Lotus Lounge, Ching Maid's biggest client and Po Po's old friend

seasons.title: Clean Sweep
seasons.arc: Mei takes over Ching Maid with no money and no staff, and hires the only people who answer her notice: four epic nerds.
episodes: The Crown and the Keys
Mei Ching is crowned Miss Pearl Passage on the same day Po Po hands her the keys to a firm with three clients left.
Help Wanted
Mei's notice for staff is answered by a guildmaster, a speedrunner, a robot builder and a quiz champion.
The Interview
Po Po interviews the four by making them fold a fitted sheet, and none of them can.
First Job
The crew's first job is the Lotus Lounge after a party, and Dex plans it like a dungeon raid.
Speedrun
Kenji cleans a whole tower in record time by skipping every room he decides is optional.
Bitsy's Mop
Bitsy builds a mop that cleans by itself and also, unfortunately, by night.
Know-It-All
Theo corrects a client's history of her own family vase until the vase is the only thing left talking to him.
Lan Yu Calls
Rival queen Lan Yu offers to buy Ching Maid for the price of a good dinner.
The Sash Stays On
Mei insists on wearing her sash on every job, and it turns out to be the best advert in the city.
Po Po's Rules
Po Po teaches the crew her seven rules, and the first is never to read a client's letters.
Rule One
Kenji reads a client's letter by accident and learns the client is planning to fire Ching Maid.
Save the Client
The crew stays all night to make the client's dome so clean she forgets why she was angry.
Dumpling Night
Po Po's Friday dumpling night becomes the crew's favourite meeting, and Dex makes the worst dumpling in history.
The Guild
Dex brings his whole role-play guild to clean the convention dome in costume.
Cosplay Clean
Pearl Passage is scandalised and delighted by forty knights polishing the walkways.
The Clockwork Queen
Jade Tsai's cleaning gadgets beat Bitsy's mop at a demonstration, and Bitsy wants a rematch.
Gadget Duel
Bitsy and Jade duel with machines in a dusty tower and accidentally invent a better vacuum together.
Theo's Crush
Theo practises asking Mei to dinner by reading her quiz questions she always gets right.
The Lost Key
Po Po's oldest key goes missing, and with it the key to a room nobody remembers.
The Locked Room
The crew finds the locked room in the Lotus Lounge and Vesper won't say what is inside.
Coco After Dark
Coco Wen hires Kenji for a night job and won't tell him what he is cleaning.
Night Shift
Kenji's night job turns out to be a secret party that Coco is throwing for her own grandmother.
The Inspector
A city inspector threatens to close Ching Maid for having no licence for robots.
Robot Licence
Bitsy studies all night for the robot licence and passes on the strength of Theo's flashcards.
Mei's Talent
Mei's pageant talent round is the same night as the firm's biggest job, and she tries to do both.
Mop and Crown
Mei performs a cleaning routine as her talent and wins the round and three new clients.
Lan Yu's Offer
Lan Yu offers Dex a job at twice the pay, and Dex has to decide where his guild belongs.
Loyalty
Dex stays, and brings Lan Yu a dumpling to show there are no hard feelings.
The Big Contract
The council puts the cleaning of every Letter Gate out to tender.
The Pitch
Mei pitches for the gates with a speech Theo wrote and Kenji timed to the second.
Losing
Ching Maid loses the contract to Lan Yu, and the crew sulks over dumplings.
Clean Sweep
Lan Yu's crew can't get past the lionesses at the main gate, and she has to call Po Po.

seasons.title: Crown and Controller
seasons.arc: Pageant season and the city's biggest nerd convention land on the same week, and Ching Maid must clean both.
episodes: Season of Sashes
The pageant season opens and every queen in Once City needs her dome spotless.
ConDome
The convention comes to the dome across the walkway and Dex's guild has the biggest booth.
Same Week
The pageant final and the convention land on the same week, and Ching Maid is booked for both.
Split Crew
Mei sends the nerds to the pageant and takes the convention herself.
Queens Backstage
Kenji, Bitsy, Theo and Dex learn that a pageant backstage is more dangerous than any raid.
Mei at the Con
Mei walks the convention in her sash and is mistaken for a character from a famous game.
The Costume Contest
Mei is entered in the costume contest as herself and wins second place.
Bitsy Gets Glammed
Lan Yu does Bitsy's make-up backstage, and Bitsy builds Lan Yu a brush that never smudges.
Theo the Coach
Theo coaches Coco Wen for the pageant's question round with a thousand flashcards.
Coco's Answer
Coco answers the final question with a fact Theo taught her and gets a standing ovation.
Kenji's Record
Kenji enters a speedrun at the convention and breaks the record while folding towels.
Dex's Quest
Dex runs a quest across Pearl Passage, and the prize is a free clean from Ching Maid.
Everyone Wins
Three hundred people win the quest, and Ching Maid has to clean three hundred domes.
The Long Week
The crew works through the night for a week, and Po Po brings dumplings at every hour.
Po Po's Pageant
Po Po reveals she was Miss Pearl Passage fifty years ago, with the sash to prove it.
Two Sashes
Mei and Po Po wear their sashes together to the final, and the hall cheers the older one louder.
Jade's Gadget
Jade Tsai's gadget fails on stage and Bitsy fixes it from the wings.
Rivals and Friends
Jade asks Bitsy to build with her for the rest of the season.
The Final
The pageant final comes down to Lan Yu and Coco, and Mei has to judge.
The Judge
Mei gives the crown to Coco and loses her oldest rival's friendship for a week.
Lan Yu Alone
Lan Yu's firm is struggling too, and she has nobody to tell.
Dumplings for Lan
Po Po invites Lan Yu to Friday dumplings and seats her next to Dex.
The Con Ends
The convention ends with a dance, and the knights and the queens dance together.
Theo's Question
Theo finally asks Mei to dinner by putting it in a quiz, and she gets it wrong on purpose.
Dinner Date
Mei and Theo's dinner is interrupted by an emergency at the Lotus Lounge.
The Lounge Flood
A burst fountain floods the Lotus Lounge on the night of the city's biggest show.
All Hands
Ching Maid, Lan Yu's crew and Jade's machines work side by side to save the lounge.
Show Goes On
The show goes on in a lounge still wet, and the dancers make the puddles part of it.
Vesper's Thanks
Vesper gives Ching Maid the lounge contract for life, and Po Po cries.
Lan Yu's Partner
Lan Yu proposes a partnership, and Mei says she'll think about it over dumplings.
Think It Over
The crew votes on the partnership, and the vote is tied.
Crown and Controller
Po Po casts the deciding vote: yes, if Lan Yu learns to fold a fitted sheet.

seasons.title: The Robot Maid
seasons.arc: Bitsy and Jade build the Ching-bot, it goes viral across the cloud sea, and everyone wants one.
episodes: The Ching-bot
Bitsy and Jade build a robot that cleans, folds, makes tea and tells Po Po's jokes.
Going Viral
A video of the Ching-bot folding a fitted sheet is seen by every dome in the sky.
Orders
A thousand orders for Ching-bots arrive in a day, and Ching Maid has no factory.
Kenji's Factory
Kenji designs the fastest assembly line in Once City, mostly by skipping steps.
The Recall
Half the Ching-bots tell jokes at funerals, and they all have to come back.
Po Po's Jokes
Po Po teaches the robots when not to tell jokes, which is a lesson for Dex too.
The Bot That Cried
One Ching-bot learns to cry at sad films, and Bitsy can't bring herself to fix it.
Lan Yu's Fear
Lan Yu fears robots will put her human crew out of work.
Robots and Hands
Mei promises every Ching-bot works beside a person, never instead of one.
The Union
The city's cleaners form a union, and Mei joins it as its first queen.
Coco's Gala
Coco Wen throws a gala where the robots serve, and one of them falls in love with a chandelier.
Theo and Mei
Theo and Mei try a second date with a Ching-bot as chaperone.
The Chaperone
The robot chaperone reports every word of the date to Po Po.
Dex's Dragon
Dex builds a dragon costume for a Ching-bot, and it frightens the lionesses at the gate.
The Lionesses Object
Amber and Onyx refuse to let any robot through the main gate.
Making Friends
Bitsy teaches a Ching-bot to bring the lionesses' cubs their favourite toys.
Through the Gate
The lionesses let the Ching-bots through, one at a time, if they bring treats.
The Copycat
A firm in the Low Lands starts selling cheap copies of the Ching-bot.
Bad Bots
The copies break down all over the city and everyone blames Ching Maid.
Fixing Everyone's
The crew fixes every broken copy for free, and wins the city back.
Jade's Offer
A big firm offers Jade a fortune to leave Ching Maid and take the robot with her.
Jade Stays
Jade stays, because nobody else brings dumplings on Friday.
The Exhibition
The Ching-bot is shown at the Sky Exhibition, and Bitsy has to give a speech.
Bitsy's Speech
Bitsy, who hates speaking, tells the hall that the robot is only as kind as the people who built it.
The Gold Ribbon
The Ching-bot wins the gold ribbon, and Po Po pins it on Bitsy's overalls.
Mei Burns Out
Mei runs the firm, the union and her reign at once and falls asleep in a fountain.
The Crew Takes Over
The crew runs Ching Maid for a week so Mei can rest, and nothing goes right.
Mei Returns
Mei comes back to find the crew has redecorated the shop as a guild hall.
The Guild Hall
Mei keeps the guild hall, and the clients love it.
Po Po's Secret
Po Po tells Mei the lost key from the first season opens a room under the shop.
Under the Shop
Under the shop is the very first Ching Maid sign, from the old days, before the name was changed.
The Robot Maid
The crew hangs the old sign beside the new one, and the Ching-bots polish both.

seasons.title: Lantern Night
seasons.arc: The Lantern Festival comes to Pearl Passage; Po Po plans her retirement, the crew grows up, and Ching Maid becomes a family.
episodes: Lantern Season
The Lantern Festival is coming, and Ching Maid is asked to hang every lantern in Pearl Passage.
Ten Thousand Lanterns
Kenji calculates how fast ten thousand lanterns can be hung, and is wrong by a week.
Po Po Retires
Po Po announces she will retire on Lantern Night, and the crew refuses to accept it.
The Plan
Dex plans the greatest Lantern Night in history as Po Po's farewell.
Secret Rehearsals
The crew rehearses a dance for Po Po in secret, and Kenji has two left feet.
Vesper Helps
Vesper lends the Lotus Lounge's dancers to teach the crew the steps.
Pip's Class
Pip the sprite gives Kenji a dance lesson and he finally finds the beat.
Lan Yu's Lanterns
Lan Yu's crew makes lanterns shaped like every queen's sash.
The Missing Lantern
Po Po's own lantern, from her first festival, has gone missing.
The Lantern Hunt
The crew searches every dome in Pearl Passage for Po Po's lantern.
Coco Knows
Coco Wen knows where the lantern is, and won't say until the festival.
Theo Proposes
Theo tries to propose to Mei and is interrupted by a falling lantern.
Second Try
Theo tries again at dumpling night and Po Po answers yes for her.
Mei's Answer
Mei says yes herself the next morning, in her sash, on the walkway.
Bitsy and Jade
Bitsy and Jade open a workshop together in the room under the shop.
Dex's Guild Grows
Dex's guild becomes the biggest club in Once City, and half of them work for Ching Maid.
Kenji's Last Run
Kenji retires from speedrunning to run the firm's schedule, and finds he likes going slowly.
The Rain
Rain threatens to ruin the lanterns, and the Ching-bots hold umbrellas over every one.
The Storm Bell
The storm bell rings, and the festival may have to be called off.
Lantern in the Storm
The crew hangs the last lanterns in the storm while the lionesses guard the ladders.
The Sky Clears
The storm passes on the evening of the festival, as if Po Po had arranged it.
Lantern Night
Ten thousand lanterns float over Pearl Passage, and Po Po's is the last.
Coco's Gift
Coco reveals she found Po Po's lantern and mended it, and gives it back at the river.
The Farewell Dance
The crew dances for Po Po on the lantern walkway, and Kenji doesn't miss a step.
Po Po's Words
Po Po tells the crew that the firm was never about cleaning but about keeping each other's keys.
The Keys
Po Po gives each of the crew a key of their own to the shop.
The Wedding Plans
Mei and Theo plan a wedding, and Lan Yu insists on being maid of honour.
Maid of Honour
Lan Yu and Dex argue over the wedding plan and fall for each other while arguing.
The Wedding
Mei and Theo marry in the Lotus Lounge, and the Ching-bots serve dumplings.
The New Queen
Mei hands on her crown at the next pageant, to a girl who works the Ching Maid night shift.
Po Po's Garden
Po Po retires to the dome garden and grows the herbs for Friday's dumplings.
Ching Maid
The shop opens on a Monday with two signs, five keys and a queue round the walkway.
